name: Turnip Hoe
description:
[Sword] A hoe. It has done more honest work than most
legendary blades.

name: Village Sword
description: [Sword] Kept above the fireplace for exactly this occasion.

name: Broadsword
description: [Sword] Heavier. Simpler. Works.

name: Blade of Some Destiny
description:
[Sword] Prophesied, though the prophecy is vague about which
one.

name: Censer
description:
[Flail] Swung on a chain. Doubles as a weapon, which is not
what it was for.

name: Wellwater Staff
description: [Staff] Its healing is 30% better and its jokes are not.

name: Rod of Whatever Works
description: [Staff] Whatever works.

name: Shop Hammer
description: [Flail] Named Beatrice. Hob will tell you why.

name: Two-Handed Sledge
description: [Axe] Requires both hands and a certain outlook.

name: Beatrice II
description:
[Axe] Hob made this one himself, and it shows, in a good
way.

name: A Good Twig
description:
[Staff] Structurally, a stick. Magically, a slightly better
stick.

name: Secondhand Wand
description: [Staff] Still has the College's property stamp on it.

name: Unlicensed Starfall
description: [Staff] The College would like a word about this.

name: Borrowed Knife
description: [Dagger] Nix means to give it back.

name: Quiet Dirk
description: [Dagger] Makes no noise at all, which is the expensive part.

name: Last Word
description: [Dagger] Ends discussions.

name: Ancestral Lance
description:
[Spear] Three generations of Pemberton-Gores have carried
this and none of them found the exit either.

name: Halberd
description: [Spear] Reach, and a great deal of it.

name: Oathkeeper
description:
[Spear] Sir Aldric swore on it once and has been extremely
careful with it since.

name: Dented Lute
description:
[Whip] Swung by the neck. The strings survive this better
than you would think.

name: Road Fiddle
description:
[Whip] Loud enough to be heard over a battle, which is the
point.

name: The Instrument of Legend
description:
[Whip] Piper wrote the legend first and then had the
instrument made to match.

name: Notched Black Sword
description:
[Sword] Black, notched, and carried since he was nineteen.
He will not say where the notches came from.

name: Grudge
description:
[Sword] Mrs Barrow has had it on the wall for years. It is
exactly one person's sort of thing.

name: The Foretold Blade
description:
[Sword] Somebody's destiny, certainly. The label in the
cupboard says RIVAL and does not elaborate.

name: Field Crossbow
description:
[Crossbow] Light, accurate, and fitted with a small shelf
for note-taking.

name: Recurve Bow
description:
[Bow] Draws further. She will explain why that matters for
longer than you want.

name: The Final Citation
description:
[Bow] The last word on a species, at ninety paces. Labelled
CATALOGUER in a very neat hand.

name: Fairweather's Practice Sword
description:
[Sword] The one he trains with. It is better than most
people's best sword and he is sorry about that.

name: Fairweather's Own
description:
[Sword] Given away at the door of the tower by a man with
somewhere else to be. It is a very good sword.

name: The Forty-Fourth's Sword
description:
[Sword] Grave goods. He was buried with it by a village that
had not written to him in forty years.

name: Stillson Wrench
description:
[Flail] Eighteen inches of works property. Miss Hoyle wants
it back and has said so in writing.

name: Number One
description:
[Flail] The casing of ITEM 1, on a shaft. Miss Hoyle stamped
it 1 out of habit and then went very quiet.
